business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Marine Fuel Bunkering and Lubricant Replenishment

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu – International Company regime (VFSC, Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system: English Common Law and French Civil Law heritage, with customary (Kastom) law recognized under the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu; unitary, non-federal state with no sub-state tax distinctions.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–Australia Double Taxation Agreement (signed April 2016; in force 2020)
PACER Plus – Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (in force for Vanuatu since 13 December 2020)
Tax Information Exchange and exchange-of-information arrangements entered into by Vanuatu under OECD Global Forum commitments (limited DTAA network)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act No. 28 of 2020 (as revised, ed. 2021) – consolidated AML/CFT obligations, customer due diligence and beneficial ownership requirements imposed on reporting entities; Financial Services Commission Act (No. 13 of 2010) – VFSC regulatory competence; International Companies Act [Cap. 222] – registered agent and registered office obligations; Companies Act [Cap. 191] – domestic register; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives and VFSC AML/CFT regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or an authorized certifier at a diplomatic mission
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); consular legalization applies only for documents originating from non-Contracting States

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement or government-issued document, dated within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility supplier, licensed bank or public authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization if of non-Contracting State origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (original, attesting account conduct and standing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered bank or financial institution of the account holder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank letter; notarization and apostille required only when addressed to a foreign regulator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for incorporation and standing instructions to the registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of signature or Vanuatu qualified legal practitioner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (international use) or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Subscriber and director consent forms with personal questionnaire and professional CV
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a recognized notary; apostille or consular legalization for cross-border filing where required by the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or corporate register extract (for corporate UBOs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed corporate services provider or company registry of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization (management-chain attestation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of Funds and Source of Wealth declaration for incorporation capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Beneficial owner / subscriber (countersigned by licensed registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notary certification; apostille or consular legalization if executed outside Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced screening for a Medium-Risk-Enhanced Marine_Bunkering_Supply file: every UBO, director, authorized signatory and major counterparty must be screened against (i) the Vanuatu FIU domestic sanctions and PEP lists, (ii) OFAC SDN List, (iii) UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, (iv) UK HMT, EU and Australian DFAT consolidated sanctions lists, and (v) adverse-media and enforcement databases (World Bank debarment, regulatory actions). Electronic screening records with timestamps must be retained for six years under the AML/CFT Act No. 28 of 2020; failure to complete CDD within the prescribed period is a ground for refusal of incorporation by the VFSC-licensed registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry – International Companies Online Name Search and Reservation e-Portal (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in Latin (Roman) characters. Official languages (English, French, Bislama) are accepted as filed. A non-Roman-script name, such as Chinese ideographic characters, must be accompanied by a certified romanized transliteration in the incorporation application, and the registered name is recorded in romanized form. The corporate name must end with 'Limited' or the permitted abbreviation 'Ltd' under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Savings Bank, Building Society
Trust, Trustee, Unit Trust, Investment Trust
Royal, Crown, Imperial, Commonwealth, Republic, Government, Ministry, State, Reserve, Municipal, Council
Chamber of Commerce, Chartered, Cooperative, University, Foundation, Charity
Solicitor, Barrister, Attorney, Auditor, Accountant, Broker, Securities, Exchange
Gaming, Casino, Lottery, Bunkering, Petroleum (subject to sector regulator consent)
Vanuatu, Espiritu Santo, Port Vila (geographical tokens restricted where misleading)
Any token implying official sponsorship, sovereign guarantee or connection with the Government of Vanuatu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal, VFSC issues a formal name-refusal notice citing the statutory ground. The applicant may (i) file a written appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 calendar days of the refusal, annexing any ministerial or sector-regulator consent letters, such as VFSC consent for trust/insurance tokens or Reserve Bank of Vanuatu consent for banking tokens, together with a statutory declaration of non-association; (ii) receive VFSC's appellate determination within 10 business days; (iii) if the appeal is dismissed, submit a fresh name reservation with a modified name – the first amended application after an appeal bears no additional statutory fee, while subsequent reservations attract the standard fee; and (iv) escalate a disputed refusal to the Financial Services Commission Board and, in the last resort, to the Minister of Finance where the refusal is alleged to be ultra vires or vitiated by an error of law.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is NOT permissible as the statutory seat. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu (Port Vila) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the registered agent's address must be supplied to VFSC. For the marine bunkering/refueling business, a local operational anchor (licensed bunkering agent or port office) is required to obtain the Vanuatu Maritime Authority / Department of Ports and Marine license for physical bunkering in Vanuatu waters; back-office and UBO direction functions may be performed remotely.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: MODERATE – approximately 25%-35% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection for an International Company engaged in ISIC 5222 marine bunkering/refueling; VFSC and the Vanuatu FIU reserve the right of premises inspection against licensed registered agents, and the Vanuatu Maritime Authority / Department of Ports and Marine may conduct unannounced inspections of bunkering and refueling facilities and vessel boardings.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of Vanuatu (as amended), specifically sections 12–16 (registration and incorporation), section 17 (memorandum and articles), and sections 31–36 (registered office and registered agent requirements)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registration Unit, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association for an International Company, lodged electronically through the VFSC online registration platform; incorporation evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Vanuatu International Company. The Company may incorporate with a nominal share capital (e.g., USD 1,000) divided into shares of no par value, none of which need be paid up at formation. No escrow account or bank deposit is required at the formation stage.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the shares set out in the Register of Members be and are hereby subscribed, allotted, and recorded as issued to the initial subscribers, with consideration being satisfied as determined by the board; (2) the registered office of the Company be established at [address, Port Vila, Vanuatu], and the registered agent be instructed to file such address with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; (3) [name of Director] and [name of Director] be and are appointed as the first Directors of the Company; (4) [name] be appointed Corporate Secretary and [name] be appointed accountable officer for marine bunkering operations; and (5) each appointment shall continue until the next annual general meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER that the Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, execute supply contracts, and pursue all licences required for ship bunkering.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Name Reservation Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online name availability search through the VFSC portal. Submit the prescribed name reservation application, stating the proposed International Company name and confirming that the name does not contravene the International Companies Act. The name may be reserved for a period of three months.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application form
Proposed company name (with 'International' or 'Ltd' suffix as appropriate)
Identified director and shareholder details for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or undesirability, the applicant may file a formal objection within 14 days or submit a revised name; VFSC will issue a written decision within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of memorandum and articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English or French, ensuring compliance with the statutory content requirements of the International Companies Act. Execute the constitutional documents by all subscribers, and have the registered agent countersign where applicable. Include the object clause authorizing ship bunkering, refueling, lubricant, and marine fuel supply, as well as ancillary activities.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association
Consent of registered agent
Declaration signed by each first director accepting office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the constitutional documents, the Company may amend and resubmit within 15 calendar days; VFSC's objection notice will specify the statutory provisions requiring correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of incorporation application and payment of filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically lodge the incorporation application via the VFSC online registry, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent’s consent, and the required government filing fee. The online system issues an acknowledgement upon successful submission and payment. Maintain a record of the transaction reference number.
required_dossiers: Completed application for incorporation of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed)
Registered agent consent form
First directors’ declarations
Payment receipt of the VFSC filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is incomplete or defective, VFSC will issue a notice of query listing the deficiencies; the applicant has 21 days to cure them after which the application lapses. Re-lodgment may be made with additional fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of all submitted documents and confirmation of fee payment, VFSC will issue the Certificate of Incorporation under seal. The certificate shall specify the date of incorporation, the International Company registry number, and the legal status of the company as a body corporate. The certificate may be retrieved electronically and used for opening bank accounts and applying for licences.
required_dossiers: Incorporation application reference
VFSC payment confirmation
No further documentary submissions are required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the applicable service standard, the applicant may escalate in writing through the VFSC Public Registry Complaints Unit, which must respond within 7 working days; if the certificate is defective, VFSC will reissue at no charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered office adoption and first board governance actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – Compliance and International Companies Section; registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after incorporation, hold the first board meeting to adopt the registered office address, appoint the corporate secretary and any additional officers, approve the issuance of shares, and authorize the opening of bank accounts. Ensure the registered agent files the registered office confirmation with VFSC and that minutes of the first board meeting are entered into the company register.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Registered office adoption form
Appointment forms for directors and secretary
Register of members reflecting share subscription
Consent of registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a correction notice regarding registered office or officer appointments, the Company must submit corrective resolutions within 10 working days; administrative penalties may apply only for continued non-compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Maritime Authority (VMA), Marine Safety and Flag State Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bunker Supply and Marine Fuel Delivery Permit under the Vanuatu Maritime Act and VMA Marine Rules

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration Category – EIA Registration required for marine bunkering supply operations; a Full EIA Report is not required unless the project involves large-scale bulk fuel storage, transshipment, or significant dredging within Vanuatu waters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with MARPOL Annex I (zero oil discharge, oily water retention and disposal through licensed shore reception facilities) and Annex VI (sulphur content of fuel oil not exceeding 0.50% for the relevant vessel class and voyage, VOC emission control during loading and unloading where applicable). Wastewater discharges must comply with the Vanuatu Water Pollution Control Act, requiring oil separation and effluent treatment before any overboard discharge in port limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Vanuatu Fire Service certification for all shore-based fuel storage and refueling infrastructure, a structural load inspection certificate for jetties, hoses and transfer arms, and an Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) workplace registration through the Vanuatu Department of Labour verifying compliance with safe working, spill response, and operational training standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Vanuatu Government, Port Vila; taxpayer online services portal administered by DCIR
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned International Company (VU_IC): (1) Complete VFSC incorporation or re-domiciliation under the International Companies Act; (2) lodge the incorporation application and certified constitutional documents with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); (3) after incorporation, submit the DCIR Taxpayer Registration Form together with the certified certificate of incorporation, passport copies, registered office certificate, resident agent appointment, and the statutory bunkering licence; (4) receive the statutory TIN/VAT registration certificate. A pure offshore International Company is tax exempt and need not obtain a VAT registration number unless it makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu; voluntary VAT registration is available to support input VAT credits or export zero-rating substantiation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election, classification election, or hybrid mismatch election is available under Vanuatu domestic tax law because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax. An International Company may elect to redomicile or migrate into or out of the International Companies regime, and may voluntarily elect for VAT registration under the Vanuatu VAT Act to claim credits for zero-rated export and international shipping supplies; there is no fiscal transparency or partnership election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 taxable turnover in the preceding 12 months; voluntary registration is permitted for persons making or intending to make only zero-rated supplies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not presently impose a real-time fiscal clearance mandate, mandatory API integration, certified fiscal device, or digital tax stamp requirement for e-invoicing. Registered taxpayers must issue full, sequentially numbered VAT invoices and retain export documentation, including Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, and Inward Remittance Certificate, for DCIR inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for goods physically exported from Vanuatu and for marine fuel and lubricants supplied as ship's stores under Customs supervision to oceangoing vessels engaged in international trade, including offshore bunkering and refuelling operations. The operator must hold the statutory bunkering licence and evidence that the vessel departed Vanuatu or is engaged in foreign-going carriage; associated offshore services supplied to non-resident ship operators are also zero-rated as international service exports.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR may reverse zero-rating if the exporter cannot substantiate physical export or foreign-going vessel supply, or if the foreign currency sale proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, converting the supply to taxable at the standard 12.5% VAT rate. Assessments may be reopened within five years; unpaid VAT carries a default penalty of up to 25% plus gazetted interest. Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract a civil penalty of up to double the tax evaded, criminal fines and imprisonment under Vanuatu fraud legislation, suspension or revocation of the VFSC or DCIR bunkering licence, and director debarment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), in coordination with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu adopts a liberalized current and capital account convertibility regime. The Vatu is freely convertible for non-resident investors; profit remittances, dividends, and liquidation proceeds are not subject to Central Bank approval. However, all flows must transit through a resident licensed bank and satisfy source-of-funds and beneficial ownership verification under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act. Cash payments and large value transactions above statutory thresholds must be declared and reported by the bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose exchange control surrender obligations. Export proceeds derived from ship bunkering and refueling may be retained in foreign currency accounts with resident banks or converted to Vatu freely. There is no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no concentration requirement for export receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Multilateral Netting Treasury Account
Operational Account / Foreign Currency Trade Settlement Account
Capital Escrow and Project Disbursement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing class under the VFSC regime. Offshore digital EMIs may serve as ancillary receivables / payables corridors for low-value transactions, but they cannot hold regulated treasury balances or issue a locally domiciled account. The International Company engaged in ship bunkering must maintain primary operational liquidity in a resident commercial bank to comply with AML/CFT supervision and to maintain documentary integrity for trade settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory. At least one director and all authorized signatories must appear in person before a compliance officer of the resident bank for identity verification and beneficial ownership confirmation. Remote electronic onboarding is not accepted for the initial account opening of an International Company conducting marine fuel supply; subsequent routine treasury instructions may be executed via secure bank-to-client channels.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity for an International Company registered with an agent, not a direct shareholder register.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Virginia Registry (VR) extract, registered agent certificate, International Company deed documents, full BO chain declaration, passport copies, and a verified BO structure diagram with direct/non-direct ownership percentages.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flags from variable bunker fuel pricing and rapid invoice discrepancies in mountainous or cross-border delivery routes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed bunker supply contracts, delivery order / confirmation notes, thermal transfer receipt, bill of lading (if cargo-delivered), the vessel's IMO number and ownership certificate, and an independent supplier price benchmark matrix for the bunkering region.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected transaction throughput in a tax-exempt jurisdiction with no substance operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Strategic substance memo detailing physical operations, charter vessel lists, fuel storage agreements, credit preference, customer due diligence (CDD) files for end-buyers, and documented escalation path to the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Application of sanctions lists and vessel tracking for hapag-liner flags or prohibited route callers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Real-time screening system or third-party sanctions/embargo compliance report, proof of pre-shipment checks against UN, OFAC, EU and UK sanction lists, crew and cargo declaration, warrant of CSD (Certified Sanctions Compliance).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use direct SWIFT MT103 wire transfers from the investor's or charterer's bank to the resident Vanuatu bank. The receiving bank requires a precise purpose code and documentation bundle — typically an International Company certificate, board resolution approving capital injection, and constituent source-of-funds records. The narrative is recommended to state: 'capital injection for marine fuel supply / working capital reconciliation'. Funds must not be layered through multiple EMIs or shell conduits; the first injection tranche should be at least US$100,000 to standardize onboarding risk scoring.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary outbound rail is the SWIFT MT103 for supplier payment and crew provisioning. For large fleet fuel purchases, use irrevocable commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) governed by UCP600, with a confirming bank in Singapore or Hong Kong/Shanghai if price exceeds US$1,000,000. A standby L/C can be used as pre-funding security under the bunker supplier's terms. Receivables-led structured settlement via a UK or Hong Kong clearing house is acceptable provided that the Vanuatu tax exemption certificate is retained to prevent WHT claims and that the channel is transparent to the resident bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/VUV and AUD/VUV) for transaction-specific hedging
Cross-currency swaps for long-term USD/netting exposure against a floating VUV receivable pool
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed with an offshore licensed counterparty under an ISDA agreement, subject to the Vanuatu financial dealer satisfying VFSC transaction reporting obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Declaration of Compliance (International Company annual renewal filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Incorporation anniversary, with a 60-day administrative grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge after the 60-day grace period; if arrears exceed 6 months, the VFSC may issue a strike-off notice with automatic dissolution 30 days thereafter; all property of the dissolved company vests in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation and AML/CFT KYC Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (records accessible to the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary; within 14 days after any share transfer, UBO change, or director appointment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil fines and criminal sanctions under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act; persistent non-attestation compels registered-agent resignation and triggers administrative strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Continuation Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Incorporation anniversary; registered agent may withdraw at any time on 90 days' written notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint a replacement licensed agent within 90 days of withdrawal results in automatic administrative strike-off and dissolution, with corporate assets forfeited to the State.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: FATCA and CRS Classification Re-certification (Active Non-Financial Entity self-attestation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent, maintained for the Vanuatu Competent Authority under the International Tax Compliance (CRS) Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each annual renewal; mandatory refresh within 30 days of any change in principal activity, gross-income composition, or place of effective management
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incorrect or omitted self-certification triggers 30% US FATCA withholding on US-source payments and CRS non-cooperation penalties; repeated default may support agent resignation and strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). A mandatory audit is triggered only where: (a) the company's constitution expressly requires it; (b) members holding at least 5% of voting shares deliver a written requisition; or (c) a standby-LC issuing bank, fuel supplier, or credit insurer imposes an audit as a loan covenant for bunkering credit lines.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Voluntary accounting framework; IFRS is the prevailing market standard for marine-fuel bunkering books, with no separate Vanuatu-specific GAAP. International Companies are wholly exempt from Vanuatu income tax, and financial statements are not filed with or publicly lodged at the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-registered agent must re-verify and re-attest beneficial ownership and signatory rights at each annual renewal. Any transfer of issued shares, issuance of new shares, or change in any person holding 25% or more of shares or voting rights must be recorded in the register of members and reported to the VFSC through the registered agent within 14 days; the register must be reconciled and certified at each anniversary.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (minutes of general meetings and director meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$700 - US$1,500 per annum for a Vanuatu International Company with a medium-risk marine bunkering and lubricant replenishment scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500 - US$6,000 per annum for an optional certified audit typically required by banks supporting Swift-wire payment rails and standby-letter-of-credit facilities

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory zero-tax regime under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty, or withholding tax is levied on an International Company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. A Vanuatu International Company files only an annual return with its licensed registered agent and pays the annual government fee through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (registered agent annual return; no tax return)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return is due on or before the anniversary of the company's registration or such later date as the registered agent prescribes; no CIT deadline applies because the entity has no taxable income in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All shareholders and directors may be non-residents; no Vanuatu taxpayer identification number is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company registration number issued by the VFSC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registration number is the sole reference used for annual fee payments and good-standing certificates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be licensed by the VFSC; the company may use the agent's address but not a post-office box as its registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of annual government fee payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fee payment is processed by the registered agent; the company is not required to declare profits, income, or assets for Vanuatu tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the registered agent of compliance with the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No residence or economic-substance assertion is required unless the company is designated as carrying on a relevant activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return or non-payment of the annual government fee triggers a late penalty under the International Companies Act, which may double the annual fee; continued default leads to strike-off, cancellation of the legal entity, and loss of limited liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement program relevant to an IC dividend. Because the statutory withholding tax rate is zero, no tax residency certificate, no VFSC tax clearance, and no treaty claim form is required to declare or pay a dividend. A foreign shareholder should rely on source-country foreign tax credit rules and, if needed, request a VFSC certificate of good standing only as evidence of corporate status.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory on royalties and interest paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents; Vanuatu does not impose non-resident withholding tax on these passive payments, and no treaty rate applies because Vanuatu has not entered into double taxation treaties of general application for this purpose.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Vanuatu threshold; for a zero-tax IC, the effective threshold is VUV 0 because no transfer-pricing rules are enforced by the Vanuatu tax authority. Multinational groups should nevertheless maintain contemporaneous documentation equal to the Local File and Master File thresholds applicable in the foreign operating jurisdictions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu International Companies remain offshore zero-tax vehicles, but OECD/EU-aligned substance reforms require an IC engaged in a relevant activity to demonstrate adequate economic substance. For marine bunkering and lubricant replenishment, substance is assessed through physical or contractual presence, risk management, bank accounts, contract execution, and decision-making records; the activity should not be carried on inside Vanuatu's domestic market in order to preserve the IC exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through misuse of the zero-tax IC wrapper
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating or managing the marine bunkering business from a foreign high-tax jurisdiction while channeling invoices through the Vanuatu IC solely to suppress taxable profits; failing to disclose the IC in foreign tax returns and in AML beneficial ownership filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and penalties under the International Companies Act; in the operating jurisdiction, reassessment, up to 100% civil penalties, interest, CFC/GAAR adjustments, and criminal tax evasion fines plus imprisonment where fraud is established.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil to hold directors personally liable for the company's unpaid foreign tax; civil restitution, asset freezes, travel bans, extradition risk, and imprisonment in the source jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a paper IC with no registered agent substance, no local office or records, no independent bank account, and no real commercial activity; using the IC as an empty conduit for fuel purchase invoices and re-invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC deregistration and cancellation of the certificate of incorporation; heightened adverse classification by OECD/EU; denial of zero-tax status if the entity engages in Vanuatu domestic business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a struck-off company remain personally liable for new obligations; courts may impose disqualification, personal liability for debts, and travel restrictions if the entity was used as an instrument of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting fuel payments from unverified vessels or front companies, processing high-risk SWIFT wires and standby letters of credit without beneficial-ownership checks, conducting STS transfers with AIS disabled, or receiving cash payments from sanctions-exposed counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's Proceeds of Crime Act and VFSC AML rules: monetary penalties, revocation of registration, confiscation of tainted property; correspondent banks may close accounts and report suspicious activity; civil asset forfeiture follows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be prosecuted for money laundering, conspiracy, and facilitation of sanctions evasion; penalties include heavy personal fines, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 20 years in serious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying or arranging marine fuel without the required Petroleum Act licence, port-state permit, or VFSC business authority; falsely declaring the business as a consultancy while physically delivering bunker fuel from tankers or terminals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist orders, seizure of fuel and vessels, fines for each unlicensed fuel supply operation, and prohibition orders against the company and its officers in Vanuatu or the port state.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly direct unlawful bunkering may be held personally liable for environmental damage, fuel theft, damages to the charterer, and criminal fines; personal arrest or travel bans may be imposed pending criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False or fabricated transfer pricing records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating artificial back-to-back fuel sale transactions at zero margin, inventing terminal costs, using non-monetary set-offs, and preparing post-audit CUP or TNMM benchmarks to justify profit shifting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu has no domestic transfer-pricing penalty, but false documents filed with VFSC or foreign tax authorities trigger cancellation, foreign reassessment with 40% accuracy-related penalties, and interest; criminal false-document charges may follow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for signing or directing false books and records; conviction can lead to imprisonment for false accounting or forgery, civil restitution to affected tax authorities, and disqualification from serving as directors.
